title: Sexual Boost
paragraphs: …? What is going on here? The pig that was with Cola is casting magic on Cola and the other pigs.
“Buh!? Bubuh…?”
“Huh?”
Father, Ren, and Itsuki are all dumbfounded. Even Cola, who barely managed to lift his head, widened his eyes at the outrageous act.
“Bubububuhii!”
The pig that betrayed them… looks slightly better dressed. It somehow reminds me of the crimson swine.
“Bububububu, bubuhibububu, buhibuhi, bubububu, buhihihihihihi!”

The traitor pig is babbling something. Father glanced at the stunned Cola and then turned his gaze back to the remaining pigs. Then, for some reason, the pig stepped on the collapsed Cola. What is this? It reminds me of what the crimson swine did to Takt in the first world.
“You’re betraying me!?”
Cola shouted something.
This… slightly triggers the trauma I was healed of by Filo-tan.
“Bububu, bubububuhi.”
I can’t hold back. The pig squealing as if it’s not at fault—I approach it calmly with a smile. The pig, reacting to my smile, tries to leap at me.
“Bububu… buhi!?”
“I have no idea what you’re saying, but traitors must die!”
Even Father and the others seemed to have no objections to this.
“Brionac X!”
“Buhiiii…!?”
Burst Lance is still on cooldown. So, I blasted it away with Brionac. While keeping an eye on the powerless, collapsed Cola, I turned to Father and the others.
“So, Father and Itsuki, what exactly is this Kiss Boost?”

“Huh? We’re going back to that? Uh, well… in my world, it’s something that occasionally appears in gal games or supernatural novels. It’s a phenomenon where the protagonist kisses someone of the opposite sex, and the kissed person’s abilities temporarily become stronger. It seems that such a thing exists in Itsuki’s world as well.”
“Yes, it’s categorized as Sexual Boost. It’s an ability that temporarily enhances one’s powers.”
What? Such an ability exists? That’s the kind of power the old me would have desperately wanted.
“If I had kept fighting at their initial speed, I might have been caught off guard.”
Ren nodded, looking like he wasn’t sure how to react.
“So, this world has a technique that enhances abilities through a kiss?”
If it does exist, I would love to kiss Filo-tan.
Oh! No, that’s not right. I am a faithful man. I want to maintain a wholesome relationship with Filo-tan until the world is at peace.
“However, even considering all the loops so far, this is the first time I’ve heard that a kiss can enhance abilities.”
“I wonder… Trying it out seems kind of wrong…”
“Something about this makes me feel sad.”
“Naofumi, you’ve got plenty of people around you. Why don’t you try it out?”
“Ren, is that how you see the people around me!? They’re all kids, you know? Besides, why don’t you try it out with Éclair instead?”
“Why the hell do I have to do that with Éclair!?”
Father and the others have started another pointless argument.
“By the way, regarding Sexual Boost… it ranges from the mild to the extreme, with the lowest being a kiss and the highest being…”
That’s where Itsuki trailed off.
Why is he getting embarrassed now?
“It seems like a useful ability.”
“It has its advantages, but it wasn’t exactly a well-received power.”
“Ah… I mean, even if it strengthens abilities, I can’t imagine a situation where you’d need to go all the way from a kiss to… ahem.”
“Yes, even if it’s recognized as a supernatural ability, many would hide it. It’s not something people would easily admit to.”
I imagine Itsuki’s world. A school entrance ceremony where those with supernatural abilities gather.
During classroom introductions, how would I introduce myself if I had this ability? ‘I am Motoyasu Kitamura! My ability is Sexual Boost!’ …If it were pigs, I wouldn’t feel embarrassed at all.
But what if it were the Filolials?
Uwaaaaah! I wouldn’t be able to bear it!
“What a bundle of impure thoughts.”

“That’s exactly what it is… If a person could build a good relationship with their partner, it might work out, but if this ability were used for personal gain, they’d be arrested. Even as a countermeasure for supernatural crimes… it’s still something people reject.”
“It boosts physical abilities too, so… maybe it’s not so bad?”
“It’s useful, but it puts a lot of strain on the body…”
So, in Itsuki’s world, there are a lot of restrictions.
“In the end, it’s just you now, Yuta… No, wait. Wasn’t your real name Yuta Fujii-dera? I’ll capture you and get the details.”
“Oh? Did something new come up?”
I’m surprised by this sudden revelation.
“Yeah. The person Motoyasu-kun just killed casually let that slip. He’s not like Takt, but apparently, this guy came from Japan in another world like us.”

“He was of unknown origin but seemed to be acquainted with that well-dressed woman Motoyasu-san just killed and had been adventuring with her. Apparently, the one who betrayed them was the only noble among them.”
“However, it seems he didn’t know much about the Throwing Weapon Hero. The previous owner was apparently someone from this world.”
This is strange, isn’t it? If this guy killed the Seven Star Hero and stole their weapon, then the opponent must be someone from another world like us.
“Either way, it felt like they stole a trump card and tried to gain favor by leaking information.”
“It was really disgusting.”
“Yeah. Finishing off a comrade and claiming ‘I’m the victim here’… that’s just too much…”
“U… ugh…”
Father gently lifts the crying Cola.

“The first one… I know saying sorry doesn’t fix anything, but I’m sorry… But since you all came here intending to kill us, we’re not going to show any more mercy. I want you to tell me why you had the throwing weapon and why you’re in another world even though you weren’t summoned.”
“If it weren’t for you guys… if only you weren’t here, none of this would’ve happened!”
Cola shows no remorse. Well, I kind of understand that feeling a little.
“Since we’ve gathered enough information, shall we finish them off now?”
“Why are you always like that!?”
“…If you had surrendered, we wouldn’t have killed you… except for one person.”
Ren and Father both look at me. If you stare at me like that, I’ll get embarrassed. I squirm a little.
Huh? I was ignored.
“Even if you didn’t know how strong we were, you should’ve figured it out from the initial clash. Why did you keep fighting?”
“Shut up! I’m going to be the strongest and build a glorious life with a harem! Don’t get in the way of my dreams!”
“…You remind me of someone I know.”
Father looks at Cola with an expression that’s somewhere between exasperation and anger.
“Can you tell us why you had the power to steal the throwing weapon and how you’re able to use the kiss boost? I promise we won’t do anything bad to you.”
“Tch! You guys already know! One day, when I was on my way home, I got hit by a truck, and when I came to, there was a god in front of me—ugh…”
Just as Cola was about to explain the situation, he clutched his head and began to groan.
“Gyaaaaaaah! W-what… My head… my head… is splitting…”
“Huh? Hey! You!”
“Motoyasu-san!”
“It’s not me, I swear!”
“Then what the hell is happening…?”
Even as we spoke, Cola continued to writhe in pain, clutching his head.
What’s making him suffer so much?
“Gyaaaaaaaah—!”
With a sickening splat, an unpleasant sound echoed, and Cola’s head exploded. After that, we witnessed something glowing where Cola had been standing.
What is that? It felt somewhat like when that ghostly crimson swine appeared… It seems like something that resembled a soul was also obliterated.
“Did he… just die all of a sudden…?”
“W-what the hell just happened?”
Father and the others are flustered. I really have no idea what’s going on.
Chapter 690 – Conflict
“If we think about it calmly… perhaps something was behind this Yuta person?”
“Considering everything, it’s safest to assume he was silenced.”
Father turns his gaze toward the floating throwing weapon. As the commotion settled, the Filolials and Éclair approached us.
“What happened?”
“Ah… when we pressed him about hiding the throwing weapon, he attacked…”
Father explained the situation to Éclair and the others.
“Naofumi-san, do you have any idea what this Yuta person was trying to say?”
“Well, yeah. Itsuki seems to have an idea too. With that many hints, it’s not that hard to figure out.”
“What is it?”

“He got hit by a truck, just like Itsuki… but the difference is what happened when he woke up. In stories I’ve read, there are cases where a god or some divine being appears and takes them to another world.”
“Most likely, even though it’s different from Naofumi-san’s case, there’s a similar pattern in my world too. Sometimes they’re granted special abilities as well.”
Oh? Suddenly, something Father mumbled in the first world resurfaces in my memory.
“Now that I think about it, I remember Father figuring something out back in the first world. This must be it.”
“If it’s in Motoyasu-kun’s memory too, then it’s definitely true. Most likely, the missing Seven Star Hero was killed. The Axe Hero too.”
What!? I didn’t remember any of this until now. But Father and the others answered with confidence.
“I don’t know what the Waves really are, but it’s clear that some entity claiming to be a god is sending all sorts of things to this world.”
“Yes, and it’s not just Yuta. Tact is probably one of those pawns as well.”
“Is something like that even possible…?”

“I don’t know if it’s possible or not. But considering that someone capable of killing Yuta so easily was powerful enough to defeat Motoyasu-kun while all four Legendary Heroes were together, that’s a fact. Whether it’s a person or a force of nature is still unknown.”
Ugh… If I didn’t have these memory gaps, I would know who the enemy is. I rack my brain to recall the enemy’s identity, but nothing comes to mind.
“Everyone, the situation with the Seven Star Heroes seems more complicated than we thought. Shouldn’t we report this to Faubrey for now?”
“Then this throwing weapon should go to Faubrey as well. If it stays here, it’ll be a hassle if a new summoning or a new wielder is chosen.”
As if it had heard our conversation, the throwing weapon turned into light and flew away.
“Looks like we’ve uncovered a troublesome truth.”
“Yeah. Either way… I think we’ve made a lot of progress. Also, sorry to Yuta’s group… but we’ll be taking the treasure and the Dragon Emperor’s core.”

And so, after reporting to those who knew the face of the throwing weapon’s hero, we returned to Faubrey. Later, we found out that the crimson swine-like guy among Cola’s group was of noble descent and had blood ties to one of Tact’s pigs.

Was it his sister? Unaware that their house had been dismantled, he was strutting around acting like a noble while adventuring with Cola. According to Father, if we had done nothing while Cola was hiding the throwing weapon, we would have eventually encountered Tact, who would have taken the weapon and killed us. I see. That explains why Tact had the throwing weapon last time.
“C-Could something like that really happen…?”
When we reported to the Pig King of Faubrey, his minister spoke as if he had lost his voice.
“This is still just a hypothesis, but it’s possible that this is why the remaining Seven Star Heroes have not shown themselves.”
“Bufufufufu… I see. So, should we consider this another threat brought by the Waves?”
“…Yes. In the sense that invaders from another world, different from the Heroes, are coming due to the Waves, it may not be wrong.”
Itsuki responded to the Pig King’s question. The Pig King then continued with his inquiries.
“Then, what should we do now?”
“Hmm…”
Father pondered.
“Most likely, the summoned Heroes had their weapons stolen and were killed. And the ones who took them are operating in hiding, just like Tact. Do you follow so far?”
“Indeed.”
“The important part is that the person who held the throwing weapon before was from this world.”
Come to think of it, Cola had mentioned something like that. According to what he said, the throwing weapon’s Hero should have been an otherworlder like us. Which means…
“Hmm, so there are multiple individuals like Tact?”

“Yes. Up until now, we assumed Tact was born with the ability to steal legendary weapons, but that was not the case. There are at least three of them. Our hypothesis suggests that there may be even more.”
Indeed, Tact, Cola, and the one Cola killed who had the throwing weapon. If that many possessed the same ability, it wouldn’t be surprising if there were more.

“This is a bit of a tangent, but in the future that Motoyasu-kun told me about, Tact had possessed five of the Seven Star Weapons… Based on that, I suspect there was some sort of internal discord among them.”
“I see. So even the invaders are not a united front.”
Hmm… This is getting complicated. Just thinking about how to defeat these enemies is exhausting.
“Considering this case, it’s highly likely that in the future, there was a competition for the Seven Star Weapons, not just with Tact. As a result, Tact emerged victorious in that struggle.”
“Then, what does the Shield Hero intend to do from here?”
“There’s only one thing for us to do—smoke out those who are hiding.”
“I kind of get it, but what exactly are you planning to do?”
Ren asked Father. That’s true. Cola was caught by chance while using the throwing weapon, but finding someone who’s hiding is difficult.

“We’ll take a cue from the precedent of those who hid the Seven Star Weapons. In other words, we’ll gather nobles and adventurers all in one place. We can use any excuse, like a party or something, and once they’re gathered, Motoyasu-kun can use his specialty—stripping them of their weapons—on-site. It’s easier than looking for a needle in a desert.”
“If they don’t want to stand out, wouldn’t they just not show up?”
“If they don’t show up, we can identify who didn’t accept the invitation and go after them. Considering the precedent of Yuta, the adventurers should have started making a name for themselves.”
“Strike down the nail that sticks out, huh?”

Vaguely, I recall that Father gave similar orders in the first world. If we have the Pig King as an ally, this plan is feasible. Conversely, it’s a method that can’t be executed without someone in power on our side.
“Hmm… I’ll issue orders to closely monitor any well-known adventurers who are slow to respond to the threat of the Waves.”
“No, please wait. Since there’s a high risk of them going underground, let’s proceed cautiously until we find the Axe’s Seven Star Weapon.”
The Pig King nodded in response to Father’s instructions. As expected, a rather competent elite pig. Far more useful than a lazy pig.
“Also, if we question Tact about the situation, there’s a possibility that a similar phenomenon might occur. Whether to make him confess or not… I’ll leave that to the king’s judgment—”
“Ah, that guy’s already broken, you know? No fun at all.”
Father and the others let out a deep sigh.
Did he go insane just from watching pigs mating?
“Th-Then…?”
“He kept trying to kill himself right away. It was too much trouble to keep him alive, so I didn’t bother.”
At that point, the minister intervened. He must be well-versed in the situation.
“It was assumed he might become an evil spirit seeking revenge, so we used a Soul Vacuum to dispose of his soul as well.”
“Ah… yeah. Well, I guess that’s fine? Tact seems like the type who would do that.”
“If he ended up like that princess, it would’ve been troublesome, so I think it was the right decision.”
“But I wonder… is it happiness or misfortune to feel nothing and have even your soul erased…”
“This is such a cruel world.”
Father and the others muttered softly. Well, Tact was a troublesome enemy after all.

“In any case, we have no choice but to move forward. For now, let’s prioritize searching for the missing Axe’s Seven Star Weapon. And if a new wielder of a Seven Star Weapon appears, please report it immediately. Like with Tact, it might not necessarily be the rightful wielder.”
“Bufufufufu, understood. I’ll make those arrangements. By the way, Heroes… if you find the axe thief and there’s a woman with him, would you bring her along?”
…? Even though Father is discussing something serious, what is this elite pig talking about?
